HEADQUARTERS, WESTERN COMMAND,
CHESTER.

26th December, 1941

SECRET AND PERSONAL

Dear Johnstone:

No. 1309515 Private A.W. OLDAG

Reference your PF.45000/IS.F1c of 8th December, 1941, I now enclose report of O.C. No. 12 Centre Pioneer Corps concerning the above soldier.

Yours sincerely,

L. L. Rutherford

Captain M. Johnstone,
Box 500, G.P.O.,
OXFORD.

ENGS. 1.
